description: Inhomogeneous deformation (gamma structure) for C(n+1) = osp(2|2n)

gb_matrix.description: gb_{sigma}_{j}_{s}: sigma in {p,m}, j=1..n, s in {p,m}. Parity 1 (odd parameters).

consistency_check.note: gamma(X,Y) has Z-component with parity p(X)+p(Y)+1 mod 2, consistent with kappa being odd.
